A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable versions of the same LOTS paper, with 16 pages including supplementary Sections A–F. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison establish that all scientific content is comparable.

before.justification: v1 reports original Sketchy benchmark results, a 14-participant human study, component ablations, and qualitative generation experiments in Tables 1–2 and the supplementary material.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark, human-study, ablation, and qualitative results reported in v1.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same pair-centric representation, Pair-Former, and diffusion pair guidance, with identical architecture and conditioning procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Fashionpedia-derived Sketchy dataset and localized fashion-generation task, including the same human-study and supplementary global-description scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in Tables 1a–1b and the qualitative comparisons. Multimodal Garment Designer and HieraFashDiff remain discussed but unevaluated in both versions.

E3.justification: The dataset splits, 512×512 generation, evaluation metrics, training settings, and human-study procedures are unchanged, including the refinement procedure documented in Appendix C.

E4.justification: Table 2 retains identical encoder, diffusion-guidance, and Pair-Former ablations. Appendix D's global-description analysis and Appendix F's qualitative cases are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Both report the same inter-annotator agreement, Krippendorff's alpha = 0.81. There are no changes to repeated-run, seed, uncertainty, or significance reporting.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–2 and qualitative results are identical. For example, LOTS retains GlobalCLIP 0.679 and human-study F1 0.722 in both versions.

T1.justification: The task definitions, spatial-layout assumption, method equations, and supplementary metric formulas are unchanged. No mathematical arguments or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about localized conditioning, mitigation of attribute confusion, the Sketchy dataset, and comparative performance.

C2.justification: The result interpretations and limitation concerning abstract attributes remain identical. Section 2 retains the same substantive rationale for excluding editing-based comparisons; only a drafting note is removed.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, dataset-construction instructions, prompts, and project/data-access statements remain unchanged, including Appendices B and E.

R1.justification: The references and substantive research positioning are identical. The discussion distinguishing LOTS from Multimodal Garment Designer and HieraFashDiff retains its original meaning.

P1.justification: v2 removes the visible drafting note '[Not sure about this]' before the explanation for excluding editing-based comparisons in Section 2. The arXiv version/date stamp is updated; the remaining wording and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–9 and Tables 1–2 retain identical content, captions, formatting, and placement. The text deletion causes only incidental line wrapping within the existing paragraph.

improvement.justification: Removing the visible drafting note in Section 2 provides a small improvement in editorial polish. The comparison rationale, scientific evidence, methods, limitations, and appendices remain unchanged, so the benefit is limited to presentation.
